description.value:
The following gadgets are catalogued alphabetically; any listed prerequisite must already be met when you install one.

  • Advanced Grounding System (requires 13th level and Prototype Grounding System): you are immune to lightning damage while wearing your harness.
  • Auto-Injection Regenerator (requires 5th level): a kolto injector lets you use your reaction and a Hit Die to regain hit points when damaged, so long as that damage wouldn't drop you to 0.
  • Autothrusters (requires Jet Pack): you can take the Dash and Disengage actions as a bonus action while your jet pack is active.
  • Climbing Gloves: while worn, you gain a climbing speed of 20 feet and advantage on Strength saves and Strength (Athletics) checks involving climbing.
  • Darkvision Goggles: while worn, you gain darkvision out to 60 feet, or extend existing darkvision by 30 feet.
  • Extended Tank (requires 5th level and Jet Pack): your jet pack now lasts up to 10 minutes once activated.
  • Flame Vents (requires 9th level and Jet Pack): you learn flame sweep and can cast it at 1st level without spending tech points once per short or long rest; while your jet pack is active, you can also cast it as a bonus action instead of an action.
  • Frailcasting Inhibitor (requires 5th level): +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Strength or Constitution save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Grounding System: you are immune to the shocked condition while wearing your harness.
  • Integrated Amplifier (requires 5th level): +1 to melee tech attack rolls, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Integrated Rangefinder (requires 5th level): +1 to ranged tech attack rolls, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Intelligence Core Override (requires 9th level): you can cast override interface at 5th level without spending tech points; usable once per long rest.
  • Jet Pack: activating or deactivating it is a bonus action; while active you have a flying speed of 30 feet for up to 1 minute, after which it can't be reactivated until a short or long rest. Its speed rises to 40 feet at 5th level, 50 feet at 9th level, 60 feet at 13th level, 70 feet at 17th level, and 80 feet at 20th level.
  • Mechanical Arm: a shoulder-mounted mechanical arm operates independently, though you can only benefit from items held across two of your arms at once. You can take this modification twice.
  • Mimicker (requires 9th level): a device casts a decoy shadow near your true position, giving attackers disadvantage on attack rolls against you; taking damage suppresses it for 1 minute, and it's also suppressed while you're incapacitated, restrained, or otherwise unable to move.
  • Miniaturized Hydraulics: your harness can store 20 pounds of gear without adding to your encumbrance.
  • Oil Spill: as an action you can cast oil slick without spending tech points, and the oil persists for the power's full duration. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Powered Grappling Hook (requires 9th level and Wrist-Mounted Grappling Hook): while the hook is deployed, a touch-range tech power you cast can be delivered through it as though the hook had cast it.
  • Prototype Grounding System (requires 9th level and Grounding System): you gain resistance to lightning damage while wearing your harness.
  • Rendcasting Inhibitor (requires 5th level): +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Dexterity or Intelligence save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Quick Start Engine (requires 5th level and Jet Pack): activating your Jet Pack now only takes an object interaction rather than a bonus action.
  • Recycled Adrenals: you can recharge a single adrenal for your own use only; once spent, it can't recharge again until you finish a long rest.
  • Recycled Explosives: you can recharge a single explosive for your own use only, using your tech save DC unless its own would be higher; once spent, it can't recharge again until you finish a long rest.
  • Recycled Stimpacs: you can recharge a single stimpac for your own use only; once spent, it can't recharge again until you finish a long rest.
  • Sentry Turret: you can craft globe-shaped sentries that stick to any surface. As an action or bonus action you throw one to a point you can see within 30 feet plus five times your Strength modifier. At the end of each of your turns, a deployed sentry automatically targets a hostile creature within 10 feet of it (chosen at random if more than one qualifies); the target makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d4 energy damage and 1 slowed level until the end of your next turn on a failure. A creature targeted by several sentries at once saves only once, but takes an extra 1d4 damage for each sentry beyond the first. Sentries have 1 hit point and AC 10, can be repaired over a long rest, and deactivate after 1 minute; you can maintain a number equal to your Intelligence modifier, and once one is activated it can't be reactivated until a short or long rest.
  • Shocking Hook (requires 9th level and Wrist-Mounted Grappling Hook): after hitting a creature with your hook, you can use a bonus action to channel an at-will tech power through the connection at touch range, with advantage on the attack roll or the target's save made with disadvantage; usable again only after recovering the hook.
  • Stealth Field Generator (requires 9th level): an augmented belt acts as a personal cloaking device; activating or deactivating it is a bonus action, and while active for up to 1 minute you gain advantage on sight-based Dexterity (Stealth) checks, ending early if you attack or cast a force or tech power. Usable again only after a short or long rest.
  • Shocking Barrier (requires 5th level): when a creature protected by one of your barriers takes damage from an attacker within 5 feet of it, that damaged creature may roll your Potent Aptitude die and deal the result as lightning damage back to the attacker.
  • Truesight Goggles (requires 11th level and Darkvision Goggles): as a bonus action you activate a truesight mode on your goggles for 1 minute, automatically dispelling illusions and detecting invisibility. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Weapon Integration: you can build a single weapon of 8 pounds or less into your harness, giving it the hidden and fixed properties.
  • Withercasting Inhibitor (requires 5th level): +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Wisdom or Charisma save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Wrist-Mounted Grappling Hook: a corded hook makes a ranged weapon attack (range 30/60) against a surface, object, or creature, dealing 1d4 kinetic damage on a hit. A struck creature is impaled and can spend its action making a Strength check to remove it; while lodged, a 60-foot cable connects you. As a bonus action you can reel it in — pulling yourself to the target if it's your size or larger, or pulling the target to you if it's smaller — or release the cable with no action. After use, it must be recovered and reloaded as an action before it can fire again.
